meta.description: School leaders and the registrar's office find rooms, exams and timetable figures in one place.

entete.titre: The whole school, at a glance.
entete.accroche: School leaders and the registrar's office find rooms, exams and timetable figures in one place.

cartes.texte: You describe your rooms, teachers, groups and rules. Planner places the sessions, and tells you why when it cannot.
Attendance, quizzes, games and polls all happen in the same tool, with the same account.
Two-factor authentication, role-based access, a security log, properly closed accounts, AI without student data.

lignes.avant: Room use is tracked in a spreadsheet.
lignes.avec: Planner shows how much each room is used and how many hours each teacher carries.

lignes.avant: Exam sessions and invigilation are kept on a separate list.
lignes.avec: Exam sessions, their rooms and their invigilation.

lignes.avant: A session that does not fit shows up when the grid is read again.
lignes.avec: When a session cannot be placed, Planner names the rule that blocks it, or what is missing: a slot, a room, a teacher.

lignes.avant: A room requested outside class is noted in a message.
lignes.avec: Rooms, their capacity, and bookings outside of classes.

lignes.avant: Going back to an earlier grid means finding the previous file.
lignes.avec: Every calculation is kept. You go back to an earlier version whenever you want.

questions.question: Where is the data stored?
questions.reponse: Ask us where your institution's data will be hosted. We will tell you the terms of the offer.

questions.question: In which languages can I read the site?
questions.reponse: The site is available in French and in English. Contact us to find out which languages are available in the applications you are interested in.

questions.question: Can lists be imported?
questions.reponse: The administration can import lists of accounts, students and teachers from compatible CSV files.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.reponse: Contact us to talk about your institution's needs.
